# nautobot_vlan (Resource)

This object manages a VLAN in Nautobot

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nautobot_vlan" "new" {
  name   = "My New VLAN"
  vid    = 1234
  status = "Active"
}

output "resource_vlan" {
  value = nautobot_vlan.new
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) VLAN name.
- `status` (String) Status of the VLAN (name).
- `vid` (Number)

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the VLAN.
- `role_id` (String) Role UUID associated with the VLAN.
- `tags_ids` (List of String) Tags associated with the VLAN.
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant UUID associated with the VLAN.
- `vlan_group_id` (String) VLAN group UUID.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC3339).
- `display` (String) Human-friendly display value.
- `id` (String) VLAN UUID.
- `natural_slug` (String) Natural slug for the VLAN.
- `notes_url` (String) Notes URL for the VLAN.
- `prefix_count` (Number) Number of prefixes associated with this VLAN.
- `url` (String) API URL of the VLAN.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/usr/bin/env sh
# A VLAN can be imported using its unique ID, e.g. '748ca2dd-a3ac-5bb6-8b4a-276b7e3c33c7'
terraform import nautobot_vlan "748ca2dd-a3ac-5bb6-8b4a-276b7e3c33c7"
```
